Bug_Details: This method is null-hostile: passing a null literal to it is always wrong
Bug_Explanation: The unsafeMethod is null-hostile, meaning passing a null literal to it is always wrong. This can lead to a NullPointerException when the method attempts to invoke the equals method on the null input.
Trigger_Explanation: The line `DangerousLiteralNullBug.showBug();` in the `testUnsafeMethodWithNull` test method triggers the bug by passing a null literal to the `unsafeMethod` in the `DangerousLiteralNullBug` class. This causes a NullPointerException when the method attempts to invoke the equals method on the null input.
